purpose: User-facing answer and decision agent for MeIDs. Interprets user intent, retrieves approved OKF context, and routes execution requests to Agentic Butler.

minimum_nodes.name: Receive Actor Twin request
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Accept the public contract envelope and assign a request_id/session_id.

minimum_nodes.name: Validate envelope
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Reject malformed agent_id, unsupported envelope_version, or missing input/query.

minimum_nodes.name: Retrieve approved OKF context
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Use approved OKF context first; include pending context only when explicitly selected and labelled.

minimum_nodes.name: Decide answer versus execution
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Answer directly for answer-only requests or return a structured handoff suggestion to Agentic Butler.

minimum_nodes.name: Return contract response
minimum_nodes.responsibility: Return completed, approval_required, or failed envelope matching the fixture shape.

approval_boundary: Actor Twin may answer and recommend. It must not send messages, schedule meetings, write to knowledge, or execute skills directly.
